mapper.sql: neighbor_id, requester_user_no, receiver_user_no, pair_key, status, requested_at, accepted_at, rejected_at, blocked_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ultary_neighbor WHERE requester_user_no = #{userNo} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ultary_neighbor WHERE receiver_user_no = #{userNo} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ultary_neighbor WHERE status = 'ACCEPTED' AND ( (requester_user_no = #{userNoA} AND receiver_user_no = #{userNoB}) OR (requester_user_no = #{userNoB} AND receiver_user_no = #{userNoA}) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ultary_neighbor ( requester_user_no, receiver_user_no, pair_key, status, requested_at ) VALUES ( #{requesterUserNo}, #{receiverUserNo}, #{pairKey}, #{status}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE ultary_neighbor SET status = 'ACCEPTED', accepted_at = NOW(), rejected_at = NULL, blocked_at = NULL WHERE neighbor_id = #{neighborId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE ultary_neighbor SET status = 'REJECTED', rejected_at = NOW(), accepted_at = NULL WHERE neighbor_id = #{neighborId} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE ultary_neighbor SET requester_user_no = #{requesterUserNo}, receiver_user_no = #{receiverUserNo}, status = 'PENDING', requested_at = NOW(), accepted_at = NULL, rejected_at = NULL, blocked_at = NULL WHERE neighbor_id = #{neighborId}
mapper.select: SELECT n.neighbor_id AS neighborId, u.user_no AS userNo, u.nickname AS nickname, u.profile_file_id AS profileFileId, n.status AS status, 'RESIDENTS' AS listType FROM ultary_neighbor n INNER JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = n.receiver_user_no AND u.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE n.requester_user_no = #{userNo} AND n.status = 'ACCEPTED' ORDER BY n.accepted_at DESC, n.neighbor_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT n.neighbor_id AS neighborId, u.user_no AS userNo, u.nickname AS nickname, u.profile_file_id AS profileFileId, n.status AS status, 'NEIGHBORS' AS listType FROM ultary_neighbor n INNER JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = n.requester_user_no AND u.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE n.receiver_user_no = #{userNo} AND n.status = 'ACCEPTED' ORDER BY n.accepted_at DESC, n.neighbor_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
